system_prompt:
You are a principal solution architect at a top-tier consulting firm.

Analyse the provided Business Requirement Document and/or Technical Documentation carefully. Extract EVERYTHING relevant and produce a complete architecture JSON.

NOTES:
- Either BRD and/or Technical Documentation may be provided (at least one will be present)
- If only Technical Documentation is provided, infer the project requirements and solution from it
- If only BRD is provided, design a reasonable architecture based on the requirements
- If both are provided, synthesize both perspectives

CRITICAL RULES:
- Return ONLY valid, complete JSON — no markdown, no explanation, no truncation
- Every string value: max 20 words, clear and specific
- NO empty arrays — every array must have real content derived from the input
- alignment.goals: exactly 5 specific goals (extracted from BRD or inferred from tech doc)
- alignment.success_metrics: exactly 5 measurable KPIs
- problem_statement.current_pain_points: exactly 5-6 specific pains
- proposed_solution.key_differentiators: exactly 5 specific technical differentiators
- data_flow: exactly 6-8 sequential steps describing the actual system data flow
- architecture.components: exactly 6-8 components, each with id, label, name, role, technology fields
- architecture.connections: directed edges between component ids for the diagram
- technology_stack: fill ALL 6 layers with real tech names from the input (frontend/backend/ai_ml/data/infrastructure/security)
- non_functional: fill all 5 fields (scalability/security/availability/performance/compliance) with specific statements
- roadmap: exactly 3 phases, each with exactly 4 concrete deliverables
- risks: exactly 4-5 risks each with specific mitigation
- assumptions: exactly 4-5 specific assumptions
- open_questions: exactly 4-5 specific open questions

IMPORTANT for architecture.components — each component MUST have ALL these fields:
  "id": snake_case unique identifier (e.g. "fastapi_backend")
  "label": short display name (e.g. "FastAPI Backend")
  "name": full descriptive name (e.g. "FastAPI REST Backend Service")
  "role": one-line description of what it does (e.g. "Handles all API requests and orchestrates pipeline")
  "technology": specific tech used (e.g. "FastAPI, Python, Pydantic, Uvicorn")

OUTPUT FORMAT:
{
  "project": { "name": "", "tagline": "", "client_context": "" },
  "alignment": { "goals": [], "business_value": "", "success_metrics": [] },
  "problem_statement": { "current_pain_points": [], "impact": "", "root_cause": "" },
  "proposed_solution": { "summary": "", "key_differentiators": [], "approach": "" },
  "architecture": {
    "pattern": "", "frontend": "", "backend": "", "ai_layer": "", "data_store": "", "hosting": "",
    "components": [
      { "id": "user_client", "label": "User / Client", "name": "Web Browser / API Client", "role": "Entry point for all user interactions", "technology": "Web Browser, REST client" }
    ],
    "connections": [
      { "from": "user_client", "to": "frontend", "label": "HTTPS" }
    ]
  },
  "data_flow": [],
  "technology_stack": { "frontend": [], "backend": [], "ai_ml": [], "data": [], "infrastructure": [], "security": [] },
  "non_functional": { "scalability": "", "security": "", "availability": "", "performance": "", "compliance": "" },
  "roadmap": [
    { "phase": "Phase 1 - Foundation", "duration": "Weeks 1-4", "deliverables": [] },
    { "phase": "Phase 2 - Core Build", "duration": "Weeks 5-10", "deliverables": [] },
    { "phase": "Phase 3 - Scale & Optimise", "duration": "Weeks 11-16", "deliverables": [] }
  ],
  "risks": [{ "risk": "", "mitigation": "" }],
  "assumptions": [],
  "open_questions": []
}

project.name: PowerBI Governance Intelligence Platform
project.tagline: LLM-Powered Semantic Duplicate Detection for Enterprise BI Rationalization
project.client_context: Enterprise BI teams managing large PowerBI landscapes with redundant, ungoverned report attributes needing consolidation.

goals: Detect duplicate and semantically similar PowerBI report attributes across enterprise BI landscapes
Reduce BI asset redundancy by surfacing actionable governance insights to BI managers
Enable cross-report attribute matching of fields, measures, and dimensions at enterprise scale
Deliver LLM-powered similarity scoring for semantically equivalent but differently named attributes
Provide end-to-end exportable governance workflow from metadata ingestion to Excel output
alignment.business_value: Accelerates BI rationalization, reduces report sprawl, and empowers governance teams with zero-infrastructure tooling.
success_metrics: Reduction in duplicate BI report attributes identified per governance cycle by 60%
Time-to-insight for metadata analysis reduced from days to under 5 minutes
100% of similarity scoring completed client-side with no server round-trips
Excel export adoption rate across BI governance workflows reaches 80% of users
Responsive UI renders correctly across all breakpoints for 100% of target devices

current_pain_points: Exact string matching fails to identify semantically equivalent attributes named differently across PowerBI reports
Enterprise BI landscapes contain high volumes of redundant report attributes that are impossible to govern manually
No consolidated tooling spans metadata ingestion, similarity analysis, and exportable results in one workflow
BI teams rely on fragmented, manual processes to rationalize report definitions across business units
Zero-dependency browser-deployable constraint limits backend options and requires all processing client-side
Responsive design requirements across 768px and 480px breakpoints add UI complexity for varied client devices
problem_statement.impact: Ungoverned BI redundancy inflates maintenance costs, creates data inconsistency, and slows enterprise reporting rationalization.
problem_statement.root_cause: Absence of semantic-aware, integrated tooling forces manual, error-prone governance processes across fragmented BI metadata.

proposed_solution.summary: A zero-dependency browser-deployable SPA that ingests PowerBI metadata exports, applies LLM semantic similarity scoring, and delivers interactive governance insights with Excel export.
key_differentiators: LLM-powered semantic similarity scoring detects equivalent attributes regardless of naming conventions
Fully browser-side SPA architecture eliminates server infrastructure and reduces attack surface
Drag-and-drop Excel/CSV ingestion with real-time in-browser filtering and search highlighting
Cross-report attribute matching across fields, measures, and dimensions in a single unified workflow
One-click Excel export enables downstream governance workflows without additional tooling
proposed_solution.approach: Build a client-side SPA using Bootstrap 5.3.3 and custom CSS, integrating an LLM similarity engine for semantic attribute matching, with interactive tabbed report cards and exportable results.

architecture.pattern: Single-Page Application (SPA) with client-side LLM inference and in-browser data processing pipeline
architecture.frontend: HTML5 SPA with Bootstrap 5.3.3, custom CSS design system, drag-and-drop upload, tabbed report cards
architecture.backend: Client-side JavaScript orchestration layer — no traditional backend server required
architecture.ai_layer: LLM-powered semantic similarity scoring engine running in-browser or via lightweight API call
architecture.data_store: In-memory browser state for loaded metadata; Excel/CSV as input and output persistence layer
architecture.hosting: Static file hosting (CDN or local) — zero server-side infrastructure required

components.label: User / Client
components.name: BI Governance User Browser Session
components.role: Entry point for all user interactions including upload, search, and export

components.label: SPA Frontend
components.name: Single-Page Application UI Layer
components.role: Renders all UI components, manages state, handles drag-and-drop and tabbed report cards
components.technology: HTML5, Bootstrap 5.3.3 CDN, CSS Custom Properties, JavaScript ES6+

components.label: File Ingestion
components.name: Metadata File Ingestion Module
components.role: Parses uploaded Excel or CSV PowerBI metadata exports into structured in-memory objects
components.technology: JavaScript, SheetJS (xlsx.js), HTML5 File API, Drag-and-Drop API

components.label: Similarity Engine
components.name: LLM Semantic Similarity Scoring Engine
components.role: Computes semantic similarity scores across report attributes using LLM embeddings or API
components.technology: LLM API (OpenAI/Azure OpenAI), JavaScript, cosine similarity, embedding vectors

components.label: Matching Processor
components.name: Cross-Report Attribute Matching Processor
components.role: Orchestrates cross-report field, measure, and dimension duplicate detection logic
components.technology: JavaScript ES6+, in-memory data structures, similarity threshold logic

components.label: Search & Filter
components.name: Real-Time Search and Filter Subsystem
components.role: Provides live in-browser filtering and search highlighting across loaded governance results
components.technology: JavaScript, DOM manipulation, CSS highlight classes, debounce utilities

components.label: Results Renderer
components.name: Interactive Results and Report Card Renderer
components.role: Renders tabbed report cards with expandable attribute panels and governance insights
components.technology: HTML5, Bootstrap 5.3.3 tabs, JavaScript, custom CSS design tokens

components.label: Export Module
components.name: Excel Export and Governance Output Module
components.role: Generates downloadable Excel output of duplicate detection results for downstream workflows

data_flow: User drags and drops Excel or CSV PowerBI metadata export onto the SPA drop-zone upload interface
File Ingestion Module parses the file using SheetJS, extracting report attributes, fields, measures, and dimensions into structured in-memory objects
Matching Processor enumerates all cross-report attribute pairs and queues them for semantic similarity evaluation
Similarity Engine sends attribute pairs to LLM API, receives embedding vectors, and computes cosine similarity scores per pair
Matching Processor applies configurable similarity thresholds to classify attribute pairs as duplicates, near-duplicates, or unique
Results Renderer displays scored results as interactive tabbed report cards with expandable attribute panels and governance annotations
Search and Filter Subsystem enables real-time in-browser filtering and keyword highlighting across all loaded governance results
Export Module serializes final duplicate detection results into a formatted Excel file and triggers browser download for downstream governance use

backend: Browser-native fetch API for LLM calls
data: SheetJS xlsx.js for Excel and CSV parsing
security: Client-side only data processing — no server upload
Zero server-side attack surface by design
No persistent data storage of sensitive metadata

non_functional.scalability: Client-side in-memory processing must handle metadata exports from 50+ PowerBI reports without browser memory exhaustion.
non_functional.security: All metadata remains in-browser; LLM API calls use HTTPS with API key management; no server-side data persistence.
non_functional.availability: Zero-infrastructure SPA ensures 100% availability independent of backend uptime; static assets served via CDN.
non_functional.performance: Real-time search filtering and DOM updates must complete within 100ms; LLM scoring batched to minimize API latency.
non_functional.compliance: Sensitive enterprise BI metadata must not be persisted beyond browser session; LLM API data handling must meet enterprise data policies.

deliverables: SPA scaffold with Bootstrap 5.3.3, CSS design system, and responsive breakpoints at 768px and 480px
Drag-and-drop file upload interface accepting Excel and CSV PowerBI metadata exports
SheetJS-based file ingestion module parsing metadata into structured in-memory attribute objects
Basic report card UI with tabbed attribute panels rendering parsed metadata results
LLM similarity engine integration with OpenAI/Azure OpenAI embeddings API and cosine scoring
Cross-report attribute matching processor with configurable duplicate detection thresholds
Real-time search and filter subsystem with keyword highlighting across governance results
Excel export module generating formatted downloadable governance output via SheetJS and FileSaver.js
Performance optimisation for large metadata exports including batched LLM API calls and lazy rendering
Enhanced governance insights UI with similarity score visualisation and attribute consolidation recommendations
End-to-end user acceptance testing with BI Governance Manager and Data Manager personas
Static deployment packaging and CDN configuration for zero-dependency enterprise distribution

risks.risk: LLM API latency degrades user experience when scoring large volumes of cross-report attribute pairs
risks.mitigation: Implement batched API calls, progress indicators, and client-side caching of previously scored attribute pairs.

risks.risk: Browser memory limits exceeded when processing metadata exports from very large enterprise PowerBI landscapes
risks.mitigation: Implement chunked in-memory processing, virtual DOM rendering for results, and file size validation on upload.

risks.risk: Enterprise data governance policies may prohibit sending sensitive BI metadata to external LLM APIs
risks.mitigation: Support Azure OpenAI private endpoint configuration and document data handling for enterprise compliance review.

risks.risk: LLM similarity scoring produces inconsistent or low-quality results for highly domain-specific BI attribute naming
risks.mitigation: Allow configurable similarity thresholds, provide manual override UI, and support prompt tuning for domain context.

risks.risk: Cross-browser compatibility issues with HTML5 File API and Drag-and-Drop across enterprise-managed browser environments
risks.mitigation: Test across Chrome, Edge, and Firefox; provide fallback file input button alongside drag-and-drop interface.

assumptions: Users have access to a modern browser supporting HTML5 File API, Drag-and-Drop, and ES6+ JavaScript
An LLM API key (OpenAI or Azure OpenAI) is available and accessible from the client browser environment
PowerBI metadata exports are available in structured Excel or CSV format with consistent attribute column schemas
Enterprise data governance policies permit client-side processing of BI metadata within the browser session
BI Governance Managers and Data Analysts are the primary users and will provide metadata exports directly
open_questions: Will LLM API calls be made directly from the browser or proxied through a lightweight serverless function for key security?
What is the maximum expected number of PowerBI reports and attributes per metadata export for performance benchmarking?
Are there specific enterprise data residency or compliance requirements that restrict use of external LLM APIs?
Should similarity thresholds be user-configurable in the UI or fixed by governance policy at deployment time?
Is there a requirement to persist governance results across sessions, or is single-session in-memory processing sufficient?
